verdict.rationale: OneDrive/Graph docs show event-detection primitives (change notifications, delta query) that could be used by developers to build automation, but there is no evidence of a native, user-definable 'if event then action' rules engine (e.g., Power Automate integration) within OneDrive itself, nor any AI-native tooling for this. Missing for 10: documented rule-definition UI/API, integration with automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate), and evidence of actual trigger-action workflows being built rather than raw change-notification primitives.
